_doc: Script-local flags: progress markers a dialogue or a location sets and reads, with no codex page, no affinity and no ending. They are not flags (Data.flags, the codex and the Possibility Engine never list them); declaring one here lets the dialogue check (DialogueCheck, lint_data.py) tell a marker from a typo. A dialogue flag must be a data/flags flag with one of its states, or one of these with one of its states.

script_local.where: prologue.json prologue_courtyard; guardia_courtyard.gd skips the courtyard script once it is set
prologue.json prologue_breakfast; each option carries its own affinity (DECISIONS "Crono's first lie")
chapter1.json ch1_arrival; the prologue probe waits for it
atrium_horologe.gd leave_for_fair sets it; chapter1.json ch1_fair_call reads it
chapter1.json atrium_workbench (the small Bekkler doll is taken once)
